verification.scope: Gewyvern library and seven targeted integration suites, plus native-validation and project-status closure suites; not a whole-workspace test or release gate

cleanup.note: Capture inventories differ only by this turn's temporary build container; after its removal, final container identities exactly match the pre-turn inventory. Failed development capture and MQTT/NATS control are excluded from final SMTP totals.

limitations: one physical host/kernel, not independent-host qualification
bounded plaintext Mailpit SMTP only, no TLS or generic protocol detection
no SMTP command/reply correlation in production packet rules; canonical case-sensitive English signatures can miss other servers, localized text, single-line EHLO or split prefixes
real SMTP data-denied coverage is negative-only; no real post-body rejection positive
client body input is not captured request payload or validated mailbox content
queue acknowledgement is not external delivery or durable storage proof
no IMAP/POP3/LMTP, external forwarding, broker crash, performance or vulnerability-detection claim
native transcript and captured transcript share the same bounded parser, but input byte sources are independent; partial client reads are not TCP segment boundaries
